title: Beyond Questions: Evaluating the Stated Knowledge of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.26937v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Parametric knowledge in large language models (LLMs) is a cornerstone of their success, yet remains poorly understood. Existing knowledge benchmarks typically rely on predefined questions (e.g., "What is the birth date of M.L. King?"), evaluating only knowledge that benchmark designers explicitly choose to query, a problematic availability bias. In this paper, we introduce open knowledge evaluation, a new paradigm for benchmarking the stated knowledge of LLMs. Instead of asking narrow questions, it evaluates models on the knowledge they choose to surface in response to open-ended elicitation prompts (e.g., "Tell me everything you know about M.L. King"). This shifts the focus from predefined answer retrieval toward characterizing the knowledge models naturally express. translated_title: 超越提问：评估大语言模型的陈述性知识
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中的参数化知识是其成功的基石，但人们对它的理解仍然不足。现有的知识评测基准通常依赖于预定义的问题（例如“M.L. King的出生日期是什么？”），仅评估基准设计者明确选择查询的知识，这是一种有问题的可用性偏差。在本文中，我们提出了开放式知识评估，这是一种用于评测大语言模型陈述性知识的新范式。该范式不再提出狭窄的问题，而是评估模型在面对开放式引导提示（例如“告诉我你所知道的关于M.L. King的一切”）时选择表达出来的知识。这将关注点从预定义答案的检索转向刻画模型自然表达的知识。我们通过BeQu（Beyond Questions，超越提问）基准来实例化这一范式，该基准包含10,000个实体，并配有用于语句验证的参考语料库。使用BeQu，我们……
tldr: 该论文提出了开放式知识评估这一新范式，并构建了包含10,000个实体的BeQu基准，通过开放式引导提示评估大语言模型自然表达的知识，从而克服了传统预定义问题评测中的可用性偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces open knowledge evaluation, a new paradigm instantiated as the BeQu benchmark of 10,000 entities, which assesses the knowledge LLMs naturally express in response to open-ended prompts, overcoming the availability bias of traditional predefined-question benchmarks.
